titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Glory of Zion, the Fathers' Assent, the Book Found, and the Division of the Earth (ch. 17–20)
part: ch. 17–20 — The Glory of Zion, the Fathers' Assent, the Book Found, and the Division of the Earth
about: Zion, the Ark of God's law, is described as made in heaven and given to Moses on Sinai: the wood, the gold, the tablets, the manna and Aaron's rod within, carried across the Jordan and set in Judah, with the furnishings of the tent. The 318 fathers answer Amen, taking the Ark as the salvation of Adam's children and citing Psalms on Zion and the seed of David. Demetius of Rome then says he found a book in the House of Sophia: the world is shared between the kings of Rome and of Ethiopia, both seed of Shem and sons of Solomon.

sentences.t: ፲ወ፯ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ክብራ ፡ ለጽዮን ።
sentences.l: 17. Concerning glory-of Zion.
sentences.i: Chapter 17: Concerning the Glory of Zion
sentences.n: Chapter heading (the numeral ፲ወ፯ is 10 and 7 = 17). በእንተ 'concerning' takes the construct ክብራ ('glory of', here with a feminine -ra ending) before ለጽዮን 'of/for Zion': the ለ- marks the possessor. Zion here is the Ark itself, as throughout the book.

sentences.t: ወለጽዮንሰ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አቅዲሙ ፡ ሰማየ ፡ ሣረረ ፡ ወሠምረ ፡ ትኩን ፡ በምድር ፡ ማኅደረ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ ፈቂዶ ፡ አውረዳ ፡ ለምድር ፡ ወወሀቦ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ በአርአያ ፡ ይግበራ ፤
sentences.l: And-as-for-Zion, ark-of law-his of-God, first heaven he-fashioned(?) and-he-was-pleased she-be on-earth dwelling-of glory-his; willing he-brought-down-her to-the-earth and-he-gave-her to-Moses after-pattern he-make-her;
sentences.i: As for Zion, the Ark of God's law: he first fashioned her in heaven, and it pleased him that she should be on earth as the dwelling of his glory; of his own will he brought her down to the earth and gave her to Moses, that he might make her after the pattern;
sentences.n: ወለጽዮንሰ: ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'as for/to' + enclitic -ሰ (contrastive 'as for'). ታቦተ ሕጉ 'ark of his law' is in apposition, with ሕጉ = ሕግ + -u 'his' (God's). ሣረረ is uncertain: I cannot place the root with confidence (perhaps 'fixed, devised, fashioned'), and ሰማየ 'heaven' is an accusative of place; 'fashioned her in heaven' is the best reading, not a certainty. ሠምረ 'was pleased' governs ትኩን 'that she be' (3fs jussive of ኮነ). አውረዳ 'he brought her down': causative አ- stem of ወረደ. በአርአያ 'after the pattern': Exodus 25:9, 25:40; ይግበራ is 3ms jussive of ገብረ + -ኣ 'her' (Moses is the maker).

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ ግበር ፡ ታቦተ ፡ እምዕፅ ፡ ዘኢይነቅዝ ፡ ወትለብጦ ፡ በወርቅ ፡ ንጡፍ ፡ ወታነብር ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ዘኪዳን ፡ ዘጸሐፍኩ ፡ በአጻብዕየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይዕቀቡ ፡ ሕግየ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ጽላተ ፡ ዘኪዳን ፡ ወሰማያዊትኒ ፡ መንፈሳዊት ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ዘሕብራ ፡ ወግብራ ፡ ነኪር ፡ ትመስል ፡ ጥልማ ፡ ወወከይ ፡ ወወራውሬ ፡ ወዘውሀር ፡ ወብሉረ ፡ ወብርሃነ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-him: make ark from-wood which-not-it-rots, and-you-overlay-it with-gold refined, and-you-place in-her word-of law of-covenant which I-wrote with-my-fingers that they-keep law-my, two tablets-of covenant; and-heavenly-also spiritual in-her, whose colour-her and-making-her strange, she-resembles ṭəlma and-wäkäy and-wäraware and-zäwhär and-crystal and-light;
sentences.i: And he said to him: 'Make an ark of wood that does not rot, and overlay it with refined gold, and place in it the word of the law of the covenant, which I wrote with my fingers, that they may keep my law: the two tablets of the covenant. And something heavenly and spiritual is within her, whose colour and make are strange; she resembles darkness, wäkäy, wäraware, zäwhär, crystal, and light;
sentences.n: God speaks (ወይቤሎ, see ch. 1 note on ይቤ). Imperatives and jussives: ግበር 'make' (imperative); ወትለብጦ and ወታነብር, 2ms imperfects used as commands ('and you shall overlay / place'): Exodus 25:10–11, 16 (the tablets), 31:18 (written 'with the finger of God'). ዘኢይነቅዝ 'which does not rot' (ዘ- relative + ኢ- negative). ንጡፍ: I render 'refined' (the sense 'pure, refined' is a guess). ዘኪዳን 'of the covenant' is a ዘ- genitive. The second half is hard: ነኪር 'strange, foreign'; ትመስል 'she resembles' governs a list of words I cannot define: ጥልማ (perhaps 'darkness', cf. ጽልመት), ወከይ, ወራውሬ and ዘውሀር are rare or unknown to me and are left transliterated in the English; ብሉር is 'crystal' or 'beryl' (a loanword), ብርሃን 'light'. Treat these colour-words as uncertain.

sentences.t: ወተሀይድ ፡ አዕይንተ ፡ ወትከብት ፡ ወትሰልብ ፡ ልበ ፤
sentences.l: and-she-dazzles(?) eyes and-she-is-weighty(?) and-she-robs heart;
sentences.i: she dazzles the eyes, she is weighty with glory, and she steals away the heart;
sentences.n: Three 3fs imperfects with ወ-. ተሀይድ is uncertain (I take it as 'dazzles, overwhelms' from ሀየደ; the stem is not confirmed). ትከብት 'she is weighty' is also a guess (perhaps 'honoured', or 'binds'); ትሰልብ 'she plunders, steals' (ሰለበ) is secure, and 'steals the heart' is the sense.

sentences.t: እንተ ፡ በኅሊና ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ተገብረት ፡ ወአኮ ፡ በእደ ፡ ኬንያ ፡ ዘሰብእ ፡ አላ ፡ ለሊሁ ፡ ፈጠራ ፡ ለማኅደረ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ ወመንፈሳዊት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወምልእተ ፡ ምሕረት ፤
sentences.l: which by-thought-of God she-was-made and-not by-hand-of craftsman(?) of-man but he-himself he-created-her for-dwelling-of glory-his, and-spiritual she and-full-of mercy;
sentences.i: She was made by the design of God, and not by the hand of a human craftsman, but he himself created her to be the dwelling of his glory; she is spiritual, and full of mercy;
sentences.n: እንተ 'who/which' (fem. relative) continues the description. ተገብረት is the passive (ተ- stem) of ገብረ, 3fs: 'she was made'. በኅሊና 'by the thought/design of' (construct before እግዚኣብሔር). ኬንያ 'craftsman' is a sense inferred from context; I cannot confirm it. ለሊሁ ፈጠራ: 'he himself created her' (ለሊሁ stresses the subject). ወአኮ 'and not' negates the phrase. ምልእተ 'full of' is a construct (fem.) before ምሕረት 'mercy'; ይእቲ is the copula 'she is'.

sentences.t: ሰማያዊት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወምልእተ ፡ ብርሃን ፤
sentences.l: heavenly she and-full-of light;
sentences.i: she is heavenly, and full of light;
sentences.n: ሰማያዊት 'heavenly' (adjective in -āwi, fem. -āwit). Same pattern as the previous unit: ይእቲ is the copula, ምልእተ the construct of 'full'.

sentences.t: አግዓዚት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወማኅደረ ፡ መለኮት ፡ ዘበሰማያት ፡ ማኅደራ ፡ ወበምድር ፡ ታንሶሱ ፡ ወምስለ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ተኀድር ፡ ወምስለ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ሀገሪተ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ወለመንፈስ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ማኅደር ፡ ወውስቴታኒ ፡ ጎሞር ፡ ዘወርቅ ፡ ስፉር ፡ መና ፡ ዘወረደ ፡ እምሰማያት ፤
sentences.l: Liberating(?) she and-dwelling-of divinity, which in-heavens dwelling-her and-on-earth she-walks-about and-with man she-dwells and-with angels citizen-of man(?) salvation, and-for-spirit holy dwelling, and-in-her-also gomor of-gold measure(?) manna which-descended from-heavens;
sentences.i: She sets free, and is the dwelling of the Godhead, whose dwelling is in the heavens, while on earth she walks about; she dwells with human beings and with the angels, a citizen of the city and the salvation of men; she is a dwelling for the Holy Spirit; and within her is a golden gomor of manna, which came down from heaven;
sentences.n: Uncertain in places. አግዓዚት (fem. of አግዓዚ 'one who frees, liberator') is my reading. ዘበሰማያት ማኅደራ 'whose dwelling is in the heavens' (ዘ- relative, the pronoun suffix on ማኅደራ resumes it). ታንሶሱ 'she walks about' (quadriliteral, 3fs). ተኀድር 'she dwells' (3fs imperfect of ኀደረ, cf. ማኅደር 'dwelling'). The phrase ሀገሪተ ሰብእ መድኀኒት is obscure: ሀገሪት suggests 'citizen/native' (from ሀገር 'city'); I read 'citizen ... and salvation of men', but the construction is uncertain. ለመንፈስ ቅዱስ ማኅደር 'a dwelling for the Holy Spirit'. ጎሞር is the Hebrew omer (Exodus 16:33, Hebrews 9:4, golden urn with manna); ስፉር 'measure' (? from ስፍረ 'to measure') is uncertain. መና 'manna'; ዘወረደ እምሰማያት 'which came down from the heavens' (cf. John 6:31).

sentences.t: ወበትረ ፡ አሮን ፡ እንተ ፡ ጸገየት ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ የብሰት ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ይስቅይዋ ፡ ማየ ፤
sentences.l: and-rod-of Aaron which she-budded after she-was-dry without they-give-her-to-drink water;
sentences.i: and the rod of Aaron, which budded after it had dried, without being given water to drink;
sentences.n: Numbers 17:8 (the rod of Aaron that budded in the tent of testimony); Hebrews 9:4 lists it with the manna and the tablets. በትረ 'rod of' (construct). ጸገየት 3fs perfect 'she budded, flowered'; የብሰት 'she was dry' (fem.). ዘእንበለ 'without' takes the jussive ይስቅይዋ 'they give her to drink' (causative of ሰትየ 'drink' + -ዋ 'her'), literally 'without their watering her with water'.

sentences.t: ወውእቱኒ ፡ ሰበራ ፡ ክልኤተ ፡ ስብረተ ፡ ወኮነት ፡ ሠለስተ ፡ በትረ ፡ እንዘ ፡ አሐቲ ፡ ይእቲ ፨
sentences.l: and-he-also he-broke-her two breakings and-she-became three rods while one she.
sentences.i: He broke it twice, and it became three rods, though it was one. ፨
sentences.n: The subject 'he' (ውእቱ + enclitic -ኒ 'also') is not named, nor am I sure of the referent (Moses or God); I give 'he' and do not interpret the legend. ሰበራ 'he broke her' (ሰበረ + -ኣ); ክልኤተ ስብረተ is a cognate accusative, 'two breakings', i.e., breaking it twice. ወኮነት 'and she became'. እንዘ አሐቲ ይእቲ 'while she is one': እንዘ introduces a circumstantial clause. The ፨ marks the end of the sense-unit.

sentences.t: ወቀፈላ ፡ በወርቅ ፡ ንጡፍ ፡ ወረሰየ ፡ ላቲ ፡ መጻውረ ፡ ወመማሥጠ ፡ ወመማስቀ ፤
sentences.l: and-he-covered-her with-gold refined and-he-made for-her bearer and-tongs(?) and-support(?);
sentences.i: He covered it with refined gold, and made for it a bearer, tongs, and a support;
sentences.n: ቀፈላ 'he enclosed/covered her' (ቀፈለ + -ኣ). ረሰየ 'he made, set' (with ላቲ 'for her', ለ- + -ቲ). The three nouns beginning with መ- are instrument-nouns: መጻውር 'bearer, carrying-device' (from ጾረ 'carry'); መማሥጥ 'tongs, snuffers' (cf. Exodus 25:38) is a guess and the sense here is uncertain; መማስቅ I cannot identify, 'support' is a guess.

sentences.t: ወይጸውርዋ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እስከ ፡ ያበውእዋ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ርስት ፡ እንተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ወእንዘ ፡ ተዐዱ ፡ ዮርዳኖስ ፡ ወይጸውርዋ ፡ ካህናት ፡ ቆመ ፡ ማይ ፡ ከመ ፡ አረፍት ፡ እስከ ፡ የዐዱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፤
sentences.l: and-they-carry-her before people until they-bring-her land-of inheritance which she Jerusalem city-of Zion, and-while they-crossed Jordan and-they-carry-her priests stood water like wall(?) until they-cross all people;
sentences.i: They carried it before the people until they brought it into the land of inheritance, which is Jerusalem, the city of Zion. And when they crossed the Jordan, while the priests carried it, the water stood like a wall until all the people had crossed;
sentences.n: Joshua 3:14–17 (the priests with the ark stand in the Jordan, the water stands still). ወይጸውርዋ 'they carry her' (ጾረ + -ዋ); ያበውእዋ 'they bring her in' (causative of በአ + -ዋ); ምድረ ርስት 'land of inheritance' (constructs ምድረ, ሀገረ before their genitives). እንተ ይእቲ ኢየሩሳሌም 'which is Jerusalem': the fem. relative agrees with ምድረ. ወእንዘ 'and while'. ተዐዱ is a form I take as 3mp 'they crossed' (the stem is ዐደወ; the exact parse is uncertain). ከመ አረፍት: I take አረፍት as 'wall', which is uncertain. የዐዱ 'they cross' (3mp jussive) after እስከ 'until'.

sentences.t: ወእምድኅረ ፡ ዐደዉ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዐደዉ ፡ ካህናት ፡ ጸዊሮሙ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ወአንበርዋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ርስት ፡ ወተመልአኩ ፡ ነቢያት ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ስምዕ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወካህናትኒ ፡ ይጸውሩ ፡ ኤፉደ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትለአኩ ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ መርጡል ፡ ወሊቃነ ፡ ካህናትኒ ፡ ያዐርጉ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያስተስርዩ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፨
sentences.l: and-after they-crossed all people crossed priests bearing-them ark, and-they-placed-her in city-of Judah land-of inheritance, and-were-filled(?) prophets in tent-of testimony upon-them for-sons-of Israel, and-priests-also they-carry ephod that they-serve for-tent-of meeting(?), and-chiefs-of priests-also they-offer offering that they-atone for sins-their and-then for sin-of people;
sentences.i: And after all the people had crossed, the priests crossed over carrying the Ark, and they set it in the city of Judah, the land of inheritance. And prophets were filled in the tent of testimony, over the children of Israel; and the priests carried the ephod to serve the tent of meeting; and the chief priests offered sacrifice to make atonement, first for their own sins and then for the sin of the people. ፨
sentences.n: A summary of Israel's settlement and of Leviticus 16 (the high priest atones for himself, then for the people; cf. Hebrews 9:7). Verbs: ዐደዉ 3mp perfect 'they crossed'; ጸዊሮሙ 'carrying' (a circumstantial participle of ጾረ + -ሙ); አንበርዋ 'they placed her' (causative of ነበረ + -ዋ). ወተመልአኩ ነቢያት is uncertain: I read ተመልአኩ as passive of መልአ 'to fill', 'the prophets were filled (with the Spirit)', but the verb and the reading of the clause are not secure. ኤፉደ 'ephod' (Exodus 28). መርጡል after ደብተራ is a word I cannot identify; 'meeting' is a guess from the sense. ሊቃነ ካህናት 'chiefs of priests' (plural construct of ሊቅ). ያስተስርዩ 'they atone' (causative reflexive of ሰረየ 'forgive'). እምዝ 'then, thereafter'.

sentences.t: ወአዘዞሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወለአሮን ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበሩ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ቅድሳት ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ስምዕ ፡ ዘይሠራዕ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ቅድስተ ፡ ቅዱሳን ፤
sentences.l: And-he-commanded-them God to-Moses and-to-Aaron that they-make vessels-of holy things for-tent-of testimony which-it-is-set-up in-holy-of holy ones;
sentences.i: And God commanded Moses and Aaron to make the sacred vessels for the tent of testimony, which was to be set up within the Holy of Holies:
sentences.n: አዘዞሙ 'he commanded them' (አዘዘ + -ሙ). The ለ- on ሙሴ and አሮን marks the persons addressed (apposition to -ሙ). ንዋየ ቅድሳት 'vessels of holy things'. ዘይሠራዕ 'which is set up' (passive-sense imperfect of ሠርዐ). ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies' (Exodus 26:33).

sentences.t: ንዋየ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ጸሀራተ ፡ ወጽዋዓተ ፡ ኰሳኰሳተ ፡ ወጥርጴዛተ ፡ ሠቃሥቃተ ፡ ወአርእስተ ፡ አዕማዳት ፡ ቀናዲለ ፡ ወመሳቅየ ፡ መኃትወ ፡ ወመሳውረ ፡ መራናተ ፡ ወመማሥጠ ፡ አዕያገ ፡ ወአብሕርተ ፡ ዲባጋተ ፡ ወአልባሰ ፡ አክሊላተ ፡ ወአክሚማተ ፡ ደርከኖ ፡ ወምጺጺተ ፡ ብሳጣተ ፡ ወሕብረ ፡ ከብድ ፡ ዕፍረተ ፡ ዘቅብአ ፡ ክህነት ፡ ወመንግሥት ፡ ወያክንተ ፡ ወሜላተ ፡ ነተ ፡ ክዑበ ፡ ወቡሱስ ፡ ጸጐረ ፡ ጠሊ ፡ ወማእሰ ፡ በግዕ ፡ ሕሱይ ፡ ወእብነ ፡ ሰርድዮን ፡ ወከርከዴን ፡ ወዘሰንፔር ፡ ወመረግድ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘስምዕ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ትነብር ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ማኅደረ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ ወይግበሩ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ከርሠ ፡ ሐመር ፡ ምስለ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ጽላት ፡ እለ ፡ ጽሑፋን ፡ በአጽባዕተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወትነብር ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: Vessels-of gold: lamps(?) and-cups, bowls(?) and-tables, dishes(?) and-heads-of pillars, candlesticks and-pitchers, vessels-for-sealing(?) and-pourers(?), tongs(?) bands(?) and-censers(?) brocades and-garments crowns and-wreaths(?) ?, and-plates(?) ?, and-colour-of liver(?), perfume of-anointing-of priesthood and-kingship, and-hyacinth and-purple(?) ?, twisted and-linen, hair-of kid and-skins-of ram dyed and-stone-of sardius and-carnelian(?) and-of-sapphire and-emerald in tent of-testimony where she-dwells Zion dwelling-of glory-his; and-they-make for-her hold-of boat(?) with two tablets which written by-fingers-of God and-she-dwells Zion upon-them;
sentences.i: Vessels of gold: pans and cups, bowls and tables, dishes and capitals for pillars, lamps and pitchers, ... and tongs, ... and censers, brocades and garments, crowns and diadems, ... scarlet, the perfume for the anointing of priesthood and kingship, hyacinth and purple, twisted fine linen, goats' hair and dyed rams' skins, the stones of sardius, carnelian, sapphire and emerald; in the tent of testimony, where Zion, the dwelling of his glory, resides. And they shall make for her a chest with the two tablets that were written by the fingers of God, and Zion shall dwell upon them;
sentences.n: This list draws on Exodus 25:3–7, 29, 31–39 and 28:17–20 (materials and furnishings of the tent; breastplate stones). Many items are rare or loanwords, and I could not check Dillmann or Budge here: certain: ጽዋዓተ 'cups', ጥርጴዛተ 'tables' (Greek trapeza), ቀናዲለ 'lamps' (Greek kandela), አርእስተ አዕማዳት 'capitals of pillars', አልባሰ 'garments', አክሊላተ 'crowns', ዕፍረተ ዘቅብአ ክህነት ወመንግሥት 'perfume of the anointing of priesthood and kingship', ያክንተ 'hyacinth, blue', ቡሱስ 'byssus, fine linen', ጸጐረ ጠሊ 'goats' hair', ሰንፔር 'sapphire', መረግድ 'emerald', ሰርድዮን 'sardius'. Likely: መማሥጠ 'tongs', መሳቅየ 'pitchers' (ሰቀየ 'give drink'), ሕብረ ከብድ 'colour of liver', ሕሱይ 'dyed', ክዑበ 'twisted'. Uncertain or unidentified: ጸሀራተ, ኰሳኰሳተ, ሠቃሥቃተ, መኃትወ, መሳውረ መራናተ, አዕያገ, አብሕርተ, ደርከኖ, ምጺጺተ ብሳጣተ, ሜላተ ነተ, ከርከዴን, and the translation of ዲባጋተ 'brocades' follows the earlier entry. In the English, a row of dots stands where I give no word. ከርሠ ሐመር 'belly of a boat' I read as the hollow chest or hold of the Ark (the referent is uncertain). The unit has about 67 words and no ፤ inside it to cut at. ጽሑፋን 'written' (fem. dual/plural passive participle) agrees with ጽላት 'tablets'.

sentences.t: ወትገብር ፡ ላቲ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ እምዕፅ ፡ ዘኢይነቅዝ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ትነብር ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ዘክልኤ ፡ እመት ፡ ወመንፈቀ ፡ እመት ፡ ኑኃ ፡ ወእመት ፡ ወመንፈቀ ፡ እመት ፡ ግድማ ፡ ወትለብጦ ፡ በወርቅ ፡ ንጡፍ ፡ እንተ ፡ አፍአሁ ፡ ወውስጡ ፤
sentences.l: and-you-make for-her ark from-wood which-not-it-rots where she-dwells Zion, of-two cubits and-half-of cubit length and-cubit and-half-of cubit width, and-you-overlay-it with-gold refined which outside-it and-inside-it;
sentences.i: And you shall make for her an ark of wood that does not rot, where Zion dwells: two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide; and you shall overlay it with refined gold, outside and inside;
sentences.n: Exodus 25:10–11 (the Ark: two and a half cubits long, one and a half wide, overlaid inside and out). ወትገብር 2ms imperfect 'you shall make' with ላቲ 'for her'. ዘክልኤ እመት ወመንፈቀ እመት ኑኃ 'of two cubits and half a cubit in length' (ዘ- + number; መንፈቀ 'half of' construct). ኑኃ 'length' and ግድማ 'width' (the latter a best reading). እንተ አፍአሁ ወውስጡ 'which is its outside and its inside'.

sentences.t: ወትገብር ፡ መዓብልቲሃ ፡ ወመቃፍልቲሃ ፡ በወርቅ ፡ ጽሩይ ፡ ወኆጻዳትኒ ፡ ዐውዳ ፡ ወትገብር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፬ ፡ መሳምክቲሃ ፡ ፬ ፡ ከበሎ ፡ መሳክሚሃ ፡ ወትገብር ፡ እምነ ፡ ዕፅ ፡ ዘኢይነቅዝ ፡ ወትለብጦ ፡ በወርቅ ፡ ንጡፍ ፡ ወቦቱ ፡ ትጸውርዋ ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ሕግ ፨
sentences.l: and-you-make rings(?)-her and-latches(?)-her with-gold pure and-mouldings(?)-also around-her, and-you-make in four supports(?)-her four rings(?) her-shoulder-places(?), and-you-make from wood which-not-it-rots and-you-overlay-it with-gold refined and-by-it you-carry the-ark-of law; ፨
sentences.i: And you shall make its fittings and its latches of pure gold, and mouldings round about; and in its four corners you shall make four rings for its carrying-places; and you shall make poles of wood that does not rot and overlay them with refined gold, and with them you shall carry the Ark of the Law.
sentences.n: Exodus 25:11–15 (gold moulding, four rings, poles to carry). All four fitting-names are guesses: መዓብል and መቃፍል ('fittings, latches', cf. ቀፈለ 'enclose'), ኆጻዳት 'mouldings, rims', መሳምክት 'supports/corners' (ሰምከ 'lean'), ከበሎ 'rings' (the usual Ethiopic word for the rings; not checked), መሳክም 'carrying-places' (cf. 'shoulder'). The object of ወትገብር እምነ ዕፅ... is not stated; I supply 'poles' from Exodus 25:13. ቦቱ 'with it/by it' (the poles). ትጸውርዋ 'you carry her'. The unit's end ፨ is a section mark.

sentences.t: ከመዝ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ በደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ ወአርአዮ ፡ ግብራ ፡ ወሥርዐታ ፡ ወሕብራ ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ወከብረት ፡ ወዐብየት ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ በውስተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወበኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ተአምነት ፡ ለማኅደረ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፤
sentences.l: Thus he-commanded-him God to-Moses on-mount Sinai and-he-showed-him making-her and-order-her and-form-her of-the-tent that he-make; and-she-was-glorified and-she-grew-great exceedingly in Israel and-before God trust(?) for-dwelling-of glory-his;
sentences.i: So God commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, and showed him her making, her arrangement and the form of the tent, that he might make it. And she was glorified and grew exceedingly great among Israel, and with God there was trust in the dwelling of his glory;
sentences.n: Exodus 25:9, 40; 24:16 (Sinai). ከመዝ 'thus'. አርአዮ 'he showed him' (causative of ርእየ + -ኦ). ሥርዐታ 'her order, ordinance' (ሥርዐት). ከብረት and ዐብየት: 3fs perfects 'she was glorified', 'she became great'. በደብረ ሲና: 'on Mount Sinai' (construct ደብረ). ተአምነት is uncertain: it can mean faith, trust, confidence; the clause is probably 'and with God (there was) credence/trust in the dwelling of his glory'. Read cautiously.

sentences.t: ወይወርድ ፡ ለሊሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ መቅደሱ ፡ ወይትናገሮሙ ፡ ለኅሩያኒሁ ፡ ወይፈትሕ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ለአድኅኖ ፡ ወያድኅኖሙ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ፀሮሙ ፤
sentences.l: and-he-descends himself to mount-of sanctuary-his and-he-speaks-with-them to-his-chosen and-he-judges for-them for-saving and-he-saves-them from-hand-of enemy-their;
sentences.i: He himself would come down to the mount of his sanctuary, and speak with his chosen ones, and give judgment for them to save them, and save them from the hand of their enemies;
sentences.n: Present-habitual imperfects (ወይወርድ, ወይትናገሮሙ ተናገረ reciprocal ተ- stem 'speak with', ወይፈትሕ 'judges', ወያድኅኖሙ 'saves them'); ለሊሁ 'himself'. ደብረ መቅደሱ 'mount of his sanctuary' (Psalm 48:1–2, Exodus 15:17). ለኅሩያኒሁ 'to his chosen' (ኅሩይ + -ኒ, here 'also', + -ሁ). ለአድኅኖ: ለ- + causative infinitive 'to save'. እምእደ 'from the hand of' (እም- + construct); ፀሮሙ 'their enemy'.

sentences.t: ወይትናገሮሙ ፡ በዐምደ ፡ ደመና ፡ ከመ ፡ ይዕቀቡ ፡ ሕጎ ፡ ወሥርዐቶ ፡ ወይሖሩ ፡ በትእዛዙ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: and-he-speaks-with-them in-pillar-of cloud that they-keep law-his and-ordinance-his and-they-walk in-commandment-of-him of-God. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: and he would speak with them in the pillar of cloud, that they might keep his law and his ordinances and walk in the commandment of God. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.n: Exodus 33:9–10, Numbers 12:5 (God speaks from the pillar of cloud). ይዕቀቡ and ይሖሩ are 3mp jussives after ከመ. ትእዛዙ 'his commandment' (ትእዛዝ + -u), then ለእግዚኣብሔር restates the possessor: 'his commandment, of God'. The run of five ፨ closes chapter 17.

sentences.t: ፲ወ፰ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኀብሩ ፡ አበው ፡ ጳጳሳት ።
sentences.l: 19. Where they-assembled fathers bishops.
sentences.i: Chapter 18: Where the Fathers, the Bishops, Assembled
sentences.n: Chapter heading (numeral ፲ወ፰ = 10 and 8 = 18). Here ኀበ 'where' introduces a relative clause, and ኀብሩ is 3mp perfect of ኀብረ 'gathered'. አበው ጳጳሳት 'fathers, bishops' are in apposition.

sentences.t: ካዕበ ፡ አውሥኡ ፡ ማኅበረ ፡ ፫፻፲ወ፰ ፡ ወ ፡ ይቤሉ ፡ አሜን ፤
sentences.l: Again they-answered assembly-of 318 and they-said Amen;
sentences.i: Again the assembly of the 318 answered and said: Amen;
sentences.n: ማኅበረ 'assembly of' (construct) before the number. ፫፻፲ወ፰ = 300 + 10 + 8 = 318, spoken ሠለስቱ ምእት ወዐሠርቱ ወሰመንቱ ('three hundred and ten and eight'); the 318 fathers of Nicaea (AD 325), as in ch. 1. Bezold writes ወ as its own word before ይቤሉ 'and they said'. አውሥኡ 'they answered' (causative of ወሥአ).

sentences.t: ዛቲኬ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ መድኀኒቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ አዳም ፡ እስመ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ እምከመ ፡ ወረደት ፡ ተሰምዩ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ቤቱ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: This-indeed she salvation-their for-sons-of Adam, for ark-of law-his of-God since she-descended they-were-called men-of house-his of-God;
sentences.i: This, indeed, is their salvation, the salvation of the children of Adam: for since the Ark of God's law came down, they have been called the people of God's house;
sentences.n: ዛቲኬ: 'this' (fem., for ታቦት) + the emphatic enclitic -ኬ 'indeed'. መድኀኒቶሙ ለደቂቀ አዳም 'their salvation, that of the sons of Adam' (the suffix is anticipatory, repeated by the ለ- phrase). እምከመ 'since, when'. ተሰምዩ is a ተ- passive of ሰምየ, 3mp perfect 'they were called' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house', 'the household of God'; cf. Ephesians 2:19).

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወማኅደሮሂ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽዮን ፤
sentences.l: As he-said David and-dwelling-his in-Zion;
sentences.i: as David said: And his dwelling is in Zion;
sentences.n: Psalm 76:2 (Septuagint 75:2): 'his dwelling place is in Zion'. በከመ 'as, according as'. ወማኅደሮሂ: ወ- + ማኅደሩ (ማኅደር + -u) + enclitic -ሂ 'also, indeed'.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ይቤ ፡ በአፈ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ወማኅደርየ ፡ ዝየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀረይክዋ ፡ ወእባርኮሙ ፡ ለካህናቲሃ ፡ ወኣስተፈሥሖሙ ፡ ለነዳያኒሃ ፤
sentences.l: And-again he-said by-mouth-of spirit holy: and-dwelling-my here for I-have-chosen-her, and-I-bless priests-her, and-I-make-rejoice poor-her;
sentences.i: And again he said, by the mouth of the Holy Spirit: 'And here is my dwelling, for I have chosen her; and I will bless her priests, and make her poor rejoice;'
sentences.n: Psalm 132:13–16 (Septuagint 131). The speaker is God; በአፈ መንፈስ ቅዱስ 'by the mouth of the Holy Spirit' (አፈ construct). ኀረይክዋ 1cs perfect 'I chose her' (ኀረየ + -ዋ). ወእባርኮሙ and ወኣስተፈሥሖሙ are 1cs imperfects ('I will bless', 'I will make glad'; the latter a causative of ተፈሥሐ), their objects marked with ለ-: ለካህናቲሃ, ለነዳያኒሃ ('her priests', 'her poor', suffix -ሃ for Zion). The psalm says 'clothe with salvation' for the priests; the Geʿez here says 'bless'.

sentences.t: ወለዳዊትኒ ፡ እሁቦ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ በውስቴታ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድርኒ ፡ ዘይከውን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ወበሰማያትኒ ፡ ይነግሥ ፡ እምዘርኡ ፡ በሥጋ ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበረ ፡ መለኮት ፤
sentences.l: And-to-David-also I-give-him seed in-her, on-earth-also who he-will-be king, and-in-heavens-also he-reigns from-seed-his in-flesh upon throne-of divinity;
sentences.i: And to David I will give a seed in her, one who will be king upon the earth; and in the heavens too he will reign, one of his seed in the flesh, upon the throne of the Godhead;
sentences.n: Psalm 132:11, 17 (the oath to David; the 'horn' that will sprout). እሁቦ: 1cs imperfect of ወሀበ, 'I give him'. ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ዘርኡ 'his seed' (ዘርእ + -u). The sentence reads Christ, 'of David's seed according to the flesh' (Romans 1:3), as the one who reigns on heaven's throne; the subject of ይነግሥ is not marked, and I follow that sense. መንበረ መለኮት 'throne of the Godhead' (construct).

sentences.t: ወጸላእቱኒ ፡ ይገብኡ ፡ ታሕተ ፡ መከይደ ፡ እገሪሁ ፡ ወይትኀተሙ ፡ በማኅተመ ፡ ዚአሁ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: and-enemies-his they-return under tread-of feet-his and-they-are-sealed with-seal-of his-own; ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: and his enemies shall return beneath the tread of his feet, and be sealed with his own seal. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.n: Psalm 110:1 (Septuagint 109) 'until I make your enemies your footstool'; ጸላእቱኒ 'his enemies' (ጸላእት + -u, + -ኒ 'also'). ይገብኡ 'they return/submit' (3mp imperfect). መከይደ 'tread of' is a construct from ከይደ 'to tread' and is a best reading. ይትኀተሙ ('they will be sealed', ተ- passive of ኀተመ) with ማኅተመ 'seal of'; ዚአሁ 'his own' (ዚአ + -hu). The ፨ run closes chapter 18.

sentences.t: ፲፱ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተረከበት ፡ ዛቲ ፡ መጽሐፍ ።
sentences.l: 19. Concerning where she-was-found this book.
sentences.i: Chapter 19: Concerning Where This Book Was Found
sentences.n: Chapter heading (numeral ፲፱ = 19). ኀበ 'where' (as in ch. 18's heading), ተረከበት 'she was found' (the ተ- passive of ረከበ, 3fs). ዛቲ መጽሐፍ pairs the feminine 'this' (ዛቲ) with መጽሐፍ, a noun usually treated as masculine; Bezold prints the text as it stands.

sentences.t: ወይቤ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ጳጳሳት ፡ ዘሮሜ ፡ ድማትዮስ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-said chief-of bishops of-Rome Dematyos;
sentences.i: And Demetius, chief of the bishops of Rome, said:
sentences.n: ሊቀ ጳጳሳት 'chief of bishops' (construct): the head of the bishops. ዘሮሜ 'of Rome' (ዘ- relative-genitive). The name ድማትዮስ I give as Demetius (conventional English form is uncertain; I make no identification). He is the speaker of the following unit.

sentences.t: አንሰ ፡ ረከብኩ ፡ መጽሐፈ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ሶፍያ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ መጻሕፍት ፡ ወመዛግብተ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኵላ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ለንጉሠ ፡ ሮሜ ፡ ወለንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: As-for-me I-found book in-house-of Sophia from-among books and-treasuries-of king, that all kingdom-of world for-king-of Rome and-for-king-of Ethiopia. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: 'I found a book in the House of Sophia, among the books and treasuries of the king, saying that the whole kingdom of the world belongs to the king of Rome and the king of Ethiopia.' ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.n: አንሰ 'as for me' (አነ + -ሰ). ረከብኩ 1cs perfect 'I found'. ቤተ ሶፍያ: 'house of Sophia (Wisdom)'; presumably the church of Hagia Sophia, but the text does not say so. The final clause is elliptical: ከመ introduces what the book says, and there is no verb; I supply 'belongs' (ኵላ, not ኵሉ, is an unusual form; I take it as 'all'). The phrase 'the whole kingdom of the world' is given by ለንጉሠ ሮሜ ወለንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ ('to the king of Rome and to the king of Ethiopia'), the ለ- marking the owner. Bezold's ሮሜ here and ሮም in ch. 20 are the same name.

sentences.t: ፳ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ክፍለ ፡ ምድር ።
sentences.l: 20. Concerning division-of earth.
sentences.i: Chapter 20: Concerning the Division of the Earth
sentences.n: Chapter heading (numeral ፳ = 20). ክፍለ 'division of' (construct of ክፍል) before ምድር 'earth'.

sentences.t: እመንፈቃ ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ወእምደቡባ ፡ እስከ ፡ መስዕ ፡ ሠረቃዊ ፡ ክፍሉ ፡ ለንጉሠ ፡ ሮም ፤
sentences.l: From-half-of for-Jerusalem and-from-south-her until Mesʿ(?) eastern share-his for-king-of Rome;
sentences.i: From the middle of Jerusalem, and from its south as far as Mesʿ, the eastern share belongs to the king of Rome;
sentences.n: እመንፈቃ ለኢየሩሳሌም: እም- 'from' + መንፈቃ 'its half' (መንፈቅ + a 3fs suffix; the ለ- phrase gives the city); the plain sense is 'from the middle of Jerusalem'. ወእምደቡባ 'and from its south'. መስዕ is uncertain: perhaps a place or direction (I leave it untransliterated as a name). ሠረቃዊ 'eastern' (from ሠረቀ 'rise'). ክፍሉ 'his share' (ክፍል + -u), then ለንጉሠ ሮም 'of the king of Rome'. The suffix -u anticipates the possessor, as in ch. 18.

sentences.t: ወእመንፈቃ ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም ፡ እምደቡባ ፡ እስከ ፡ መስዕ ፡ ወህንድ ፡ ዐረባዊ ፡ ክፍሉ ፡ ለንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ እስመ ፡ ክልኤሆሙ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ሴም ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኖሕ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ እሙንቱ ፤
sentences.l: And-from-half-of for-Jerusalem from-south-her until Mesʿ(?) and-India western share-his for-king-of Ethiopia, for both-of-them seed-of Shem son-of Noah, seed-of Abraham, seed-of David, sons-of Solomon they;
sentences.i: And from the middle of Jerusalem, from its south as far as Mesʿ and India, the western share belongs to the king of Ethiopia; for both of them are the seed of Shem, son of Noah, the seed of Abraham, the seed of David, the sons of Solomon;
sentences.n: The first half repeats the previous unit almost word for word, with 'from the south' again: the repetition looks odd (one would expect a different direction), but I have not changed the text. ዐረባዊ 'western' (from ዐረበ 'set, as the sun'); it could also be read 'Arabian', and I take 'western'. ወህንድ 'and India'. ክልኤሆሙ 'both of them' (ክልኤቱ + -ሙ) is the subject of the nominal clause ending እሙንቱ 'they are'. A chain of constructs: ዘርአ ሴም ወልደ ኖሕ 'seed of Shem, son of Noah'; ደቂቀ ሰሎሞን 'sons of Solomon'. Genesis 10, 12, 2 Samuel 7. The list says that the two kings are brothers by descent, a claim of the Kebra Nagast.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ለዘርአ ፡ ሴም ፡ በእንተ ፡ በረከተ ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡ ኖሕ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ሮምሂ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ በኰሩ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘይልህቅ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: For God he-gave-them glory for-seed-of Shem on-account-of blessing-of father-their Noah; king-of Rome-also son-of Solomon he, and-king-of Ethiopia son-of Solomon, his-firstborn he, who he-grows. ፨ ፨
sentences.i: For God gave them glory, to the seed of Shem, because of the blessing of their father Noah. The king of Rome too is a son of Solomon; and the king of Ethiopia is a son of Solomon, his firstborn, who is the elder. ፨ ፨
sentences.n: Genesis 9:26–27 (Noah's blessing of Shem). ወሀቦሙ 'he gave them' (ወሀበ + -ሙ); ክብረ 'glory' is the object, and ለዘርአ ሴም 'to the seed of Shem' is in apposition. በእንተ በረከተ አቡሆሙ ኖሕ 'on account of the blessing of their father Noah' (construct chain). ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome also' (-ሂ 'also'). ወልደ ሰሎሞን ውእቱ 'he is a son of Solomon' (ውእቱ the copula). በኰሩ 'his firstborn' (በኵር + -u). ዘይልህቅ 'who grows' (ልህቀ 'grow up, be great'): I read 'who is the greater/elder', but it is not certain whether it is said of the firstborn or the king. The ፨ ፨ closes chapter 20.
